description: This file defines a final class BufferConverter that provides functionality to convert AVAudioPCMBuffer objects between audio formats using AVAudioConverter. It includes an internal error enumeration and a private helper class Box to facilitate conversion logic.

classes.name: BufferConverter
classes.description: A class that handles conversion of audio buffers between different formats.

classes.name: Box
classes.description: A private helper class to encapsulate a value and conform to Sendable.

methods.name: convert(_:to:)
methods.description: Converts an AVAudioPCMBuffer to a specified AVAudioFormat, handling the creation of an AVAudioConverter if needed, and returning the converted buffer or throwing an error.
